meta.prompt: Run a quick team poll in a card: "Where should we go for lunch on Friday?" with four options and their votes so far: Pho Saigon 5, Taqueria Luz 8, Green Bowl 3, Napoli Pizza 6. Before I vote I only see the options. When I vote, my vote is counted and I see each option's share as a bar with the percentage (rounded to a whole number), my choice marked as mine, and the total number of votes.
meta.text:
state pick=""
state votes=["Pho Saigon","Pho Saigon","Pho Saigon","Pho Saigon","Pho Saigon","Taqueria Luz","Taqueria Luz","Taqueria Luz","Taqueria Luz","Taqueria Luz","Taqueria Luz","Taqueria Luz","Taqueria Luz","Green Bowl","Green Bowl","Green Bowl","Napoli Pizza","Napoli Pizza","Napoli Pizza","Napoli Pizza","Napoli Pizza","Napoli Pizza"]
let total = length(votes)
ChatCard "Team lunch poll" "Friday" icon:"how_to_vote" status:"Open"
  Paragraph "Where should we go for lunch on Friday?"
  if pick==""
    OptionList =pick options:["Pho Saigon","Taqueria Luz","Green Bowl","Napoli Pizza"]
    TotalBar "Votes cast" "Tap an option to vote" amount:"{total} votes" cta:"Vote" enabled:{pick!=""} -> votes=append(votes,pick)
  if pick!=""
    each o in ["Pho Saigon","Taqueria Luz","Green Bowl","Napoli Pizza"]
      Row between
        Text.rowTitle "{o}{o==pick ? ' (your vote)' : ''}"
        Text.strong "{round(100*count(votes,v=>v==o)/total,0)}%"
      Progress {count(votes,v=>v==o)/total}
    Text.muted "{total} votes in total"

delta: ap an option to vote" am
